name: meme-library
title: Meme Library
description: Save GIFs and images you find online to a personal meme library, then browse and paste them with the arrow keys.
author: madeyexz

commands.name: meme-library
commands.title: Meme Library
commands.description: Browse your saved memes in a grid and paste one into the frontmost app.

commands.name: save-meme
commands.title: Save Meme
commands.description: Save the copied image, GIF, image URL, or selected Finder images to your meme library.

preferences.name: libraryFolder
preferences.title: Library Folder
preferences.description: The folder that stores your memes. Raycast creates it if it does not exist.

preferences.name: primaryAction
preferences.title: Primary Action
preferences.description: What Enter does in the library.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
